notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1786). Words follow the engraving's spelling (foco for fuoco, the truncated suon, amor, corriam, terminar, festeggiar), including the misprinted periods in "al." and "alle." in some parts, which are not sung. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions printed under the notes joined with ‿ (capricci‿e, contenti‿e‿in, solo‿amor, tutti‿a), open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced; mine are fireworks. Translation literal, for meaning.
